title: GB-Saffron Walden: UDC - Shared Bike Scheme
description:
Shared Bike Scheme -
      
      This project combines 2 elements: a) An electric bike share scheme/network. This is defined by having the ability to pick up and drop off bikes at more than one location. There should be a minimum of two locations. b) a bike loan/ library scheme. This is defined as a service which provides longer term access to bikes without the need to buy them.  
      
      Electric bike share scheme  
      
      The equipment supplied will need to be 'electrically assisted pedal cycles' (EAPCs).  
      
      Location(s) and number will be determined by the operator in conjunction with UDC. The bidder will be guided by the survey results, based on the most desired location(s), types of bikes, and likelihood of usage, as well as their own expertise and data. 
      
      The bidder should present an options appraisal based on the above. 
      
      Bike loan / library scheme  
      
      The equipment provided here will be a mixture of conventional pedal bikes, EAPCs, and at least one e-cargo bike.  
      
      Whether this service is based at a fixed location or mobile is a decision that should be made in conjunction with UDC.

title: GP Provider Services in West Essex
description:
The purpose of this notice is to provide confirmation of an awarded contract for GP Provider Services within West Essex following the conclusion of a tender process.

The Hertfordshire and West Essex Integrated Care Board (HWE ICB) was established on 1st July 2022 and serves a population of approximately 1.6m. The Authority works closely with its system partners to improve the health and wellbeing of our local communities. Services can be commissioned at &apos;place&apos; level or across the wider ICB. The service has been commissioned across West Essex place (previously the area covered by West Essex Clinical Commissioning Group).

The Authority has awarded a single contract to deliver the following services:

Community Dermatology (adult & paed) including triage - to be provided across West Essex
Community Cardiology & diagnostics (adult) including triage - to be provided within the Uttlesford locality
Community Ear Microsuction (adult) - to be provided across West Essex
Community Gynaecology adult (including triage) - to be provided within the Uttlesford locality
Interpractice Minor Surgery & vasectomy triage - to be provided across West Essex

As described within the contract notice, the Authority may wish to introduce additional and/or expand services during the lifetime of the contract ("Contract modification(s)"). Such contract modifications will be contemplated where additional requirements are similar and or complementary to the services already included in the Specification, at any given time. Such expansion would be by the addition of services commissioned by the Authority and / or other Contracting Authorities, as named in the Contract Notice.

To this end, after the award of contract, there is a possibility that the successful Bidder may be offered a variation to the contract to extend some / or all of the service lines across the other 'places' within the boundary of The Authority, specifically East & North Herts place and/or South and West Herts place services in accordance with Regulation 72 (1) (a) of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015 (as amended The Public Procurement (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020). The value identified in this notice is the potential maximum aggregate value which includes the additional / expansion of services described above.

The contract is for a period of 3-years with the option to extend for a further 2-years (1st December 2023 to 30th November 2026 with the option to extend from 1st December 2026 to 30th November 2028).

The value indicated within this notice is the potential maximum aggregate value which includes the additional / expansion of services and the potential extension option as described above. The awarded value of the initial 3-year contract is £2,334,212 (exclusive of VAT).

description:
The Department for Education has provided Essex County Council with funding in order to deliver the holiday activity and food programme (HAF) across Essex during the Easter, Summer and Winter school holidays. Active Essex will be managing the programme on behalf of Essex County Council. Active Essex and Essex County Council will also be managing the HAF programme on behalf of Thurrock Council. Across Essex and Thurrock the programme is called Essex ActvAte. \r
\r
Essex ActivAte will engage and support young people and families who are eligible for benefits based free school meals and families most in need. The programme will provide free and inclusive holiday clubs across the county that will include a range of fun physical and enrichment activities, a free nutritious meal, nutritional education and mentoring and support for the young person and whole family. The programme aims to improve health generally, including, crucially, mental health and aim to provide the families with the knowledge and support to live healthier, happier lives.  \r
\r
We are looking for delivery partners or consortiums who can lead and deliver Essex ActivAte clubs across Essex and Thurrock during the main school holidays.  \r
\r
The Essex ActivAte programme has now been running for 3 years, working with over 300 delivery partners to offer over 150,000 free spaces and hot meals per year. Over the next year of 2025, it is our aim to extend the programme so that every young person who is eligible for benefits based free school meals or is in need of this holiday support has the opportunity to engage in a local club. \r
\r
Key outcomes of each Essex ActivAte club are:\r
â€¢	To provide free and inclusive holiday activity clubs for eligible young people\r
â€¢	To provide a safe environment for young people to attend in the school holidays\r
â€¢	To provide a fun, high quality holiday club experience for the young people\r
â€¢	To support the social skills of the young people attending\r
â€¢	To provide mentors and role model through the Essex ActivAte club staff\r
â€¢	To ensure that young people have at least 1 nutritious meal each day\r
â€¢	To provide education for the young people and whole family around eating more healthy, nutritious meals, on a budget\r
â€¢	Providing signposting and support for the whole family so that they have the understanding and knowledge to improve their physical and mental health and wellbeing, support network and opportunities. \r
\r
The maximum bid value per project is £300,000.
